scope: Real TP16 CANN layer0 at P=8192, one request and one consumed token; release and exact reconstruction replay

environment.decode_reduction: Two real FP32 SUM allreduces of [1,6144] per layer

command:
set -e
source /workspace/environment/activate.sh
cd /workspace/offline/cann-streamed-layer0-20261017/source
env TORCH_DEVICE_BACKEND_AUTOLOAD=0 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 HCCL_BUFFSIZE=200 HCCL_OP_EXPANSION_MODE=AIV HCCL_NPU_SOCKET_PORT_RANGE=auto HCCL_HOST_SOCKET_PORT_RANGE=auto TASK_QUEUE_ENABLE=1 PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True ASCEND_CUSTOM_OPP_PATH=/workspace/offline/cann-workspace-owner-20261017/kernel-overlay/vendors/custom_transformer:/workspace/src/vllm-ascend-unified/vllm_ascend/_cann_ops_custom/vendors/custom_transformer PYTHONPATH="$PWD:$PWD/tests/glm52:$PYTHONPATH" timeout --kill-after=15s 300s python -m torch.distributed.run --standalone --nproc-per-node=16 tests/glm52/run_cann_layer0.py --checkpoint /workspace/models/GLM-5.2-w4a8c8 --capture-case /workspace/offline/prefix8k-allocation-20261017/capture/case-00 --baseline /workspace/offline/cann-routed-stage-20261017/continuation8k --output /workspace/offline/cann-streamed-layer0-20261017/device-00

device-00.observed_error: All ranks reject model.norm.bias as absent from the checkpoint; it is the AscendRMSNorm synthesized zero bias.
